issues.description: The problem statement uses a snake_case identifier `get_total_number_of_students()` for the method that returns the total number of students, while both the template and the solution use the Java-style camelCase method name `getTotalNumberOfStudents()`. This mismatch between the textual requirement and the code-level identifiers can cause students to be uncertain which name to implement and may lead to confusion when mapping the requirement to the Java implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across all artifacts. Prefer Java naming conventions: update the problem statement to refer to getTotalNumberOfStudents() (camelCase) so it matches the template and solution. Alternatively, if snake_case was intentional in the statement, update the template and solution to include a matching alias or clearly document the canonical name used in code.
